verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product with user accounts or stored user data, so user-controlled data retention and deletion is a category error for this product type. Its DPDP and data-privacy content is legal advice to clients (a practice area), and its internal AI legaltech adoption is not a user-facing retention control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
